groups.title: Look Up
groups.note: Wonder, passed from person to person. 1: two kids point up at the Atomium. 2: a man raises his arm to a kite between the towers. 3: a couple stands close under a needle with a giant insect on top. 4: indoors, a whole crowd tilts their heads to a painted ceiling. One child's finger, then everyone.

groups.title: Held
groups.note: The small in the hands of the big, from holding to letting go. 1: a father bends down to take a toddler's hand on the lakeside path while the family walks ahead. 2: a man carries his son, the boy's face pressed into his shoulder, while beside them a dog rides in a backpack. 3: at a concert, a mother hugs her child, a grandmother films, a girl rides on her father's shoulders: three generations holding each other. 4: a mother pulls her little girl along, away from the giant shoe she wants to stay and look at; the hand that guides is also the hand that pulls. 5: a child rides ahead on a scooter, the parent's cargo bike now behind. Letting go.

groups.title: A Child's City
groups.note: The city at child height. 1: a toddler stands before a stone giant while her mother bends to her. 2: two boys study a stranger's drawings laid out on a park bench. 3: a child peeks out through a curtain of white ribbons. 4: a girl pushes herself up the ramp to join the boys sitting on top. 5: in the Galleria, adults kneel to photograph the architecture while a little girl in her stroller stretches, completely bored. Read it after 'Held'.

groups.title: Watching Them Play
groups.note: The old watching the young, and time passing. 1: a woman with her small dog watches two boys chase a ball across the square. 2: an old woman walks past while children play football under the arcades. 3: an old woman stops to watch a small boy cross a white courtyard. 4: old men sit shoulder to shoulder watching their own game, bocce. 5: the children have gone; their bikes lie on the ground and pigeons fly over the square.

groups.title: Alone Among Others
groups.note: Loneliness inside the crowd, from day into night. 1: one chef leans alone on the balcony above while his colleagues embrace and laugh below. 2: a young man sits by himself on the castle lawn, looking back. 3: a man waits against a shutter while young people blur past. 4: at night a man stands on his phone, shoppers streaming around him. 5: at a concert, a man watches two women dance; close to their joy, but outside it. Read 'Company' right after.

groups.title: Company
groups.note: The answer to 'Alone Among Others': being with someone. 1: two men stand side by side at a lake railing, silently watching a boat. 2: small groups of friends sit along the river's edge. 3: a couple takes a selfie while three friends sit with their legs over the canal. 4: three young women laugh together under a bronze horseman. 5: on the steps, couples dance. From silent company to dancing.

groups.title: Under the Billboards
groups.note: Real people beneath the images made for them. 1: a street sweeper pushes his barrow under glowing shop signs. 2: a man hauls cardboard beneath a model checking her luxury watch. 3: women stop at a shop window; one hides her face behind her phone, another stares at the mannequin. 4: a crowd stands fenced in under a giant laughing face. 5: a painted boy holds his head in his hands while real people walk past without looking.

groups.title: Curious
groups.note: Grown-ups becoming children again. 1: a man pokes his head into a dark doorway. 2: people push their heads into a porthole to see what's inside. 3: faces appear in a narrow slit. 4: a woman crouches in an opening, peeking out like a kid playing hide and seek. 5: a man waves at the camera while someone hides in the photo booth beside him. The game ends in a joke.

groups.title: Passage
groups.note: Black and white, quiet, almost spiritual. 1: two girls in First Communion veils walk through a dark gate towards the castle; a rite of passage. 2: a lone figure waits under an arch in the rain. 3: small figures cross a strip of light between dark walls. 4: a single tiny figure stands on the Galleria roof against the sky. 5: a bird lifts off above the crowd. From the gate to the sky.

groups.title: Shared Ground
groups.note: Strangers sharing the same piece of city. 1: from a tram, strangers wait together at a stop. 2: people share the sun outside a jazz café. 3: two men rest on a statue's base where someone has left their shoes. 4: a whole street gathers around bicycles lying on the ground.

groups.title: Small Joys
groups.note: Colour. Private happinesses. 1: an old man stops beside a yellow rose bush while others picnic. 2: a small child walks along the edge of the Como fountain. 3: a girl carries red and blue balloons through the crowd. 4: a man crouches to play with his dog under the vertical forest. 5: women in red dance by the roadside as a truck passes.

groups.title: Watching Us
groups.note: Who is looking at whom. 1: a puppy tucked in a coat watches legs walk past. 2: a man's head peeks over a wall below a glittering chandelier. 3: a woman sits on a bollard under a painted woman. 4: a toy unicorn looks out of a shop window at the street.

groups.title: Unplaced
groups.note: Not in a story yet. 40 is the colour twin of 41.
